---
title: "Welcome to SSIE 641 Advanced Topics on Network Science"
---


``Don't think! Feeeeeel'' is a famous quote by Bruce Lee in the movie *Enter the Dragon*, and this is my guiding philosophy of learning.

This course is designed to help you *feel* the concepts and tools of network science through pen-and-paper exercises and hands-on coding.

## List of Exercises and Assignments

**New assignment format:** the [Pair Notebook](course/pair-notebook.qmd) — a one-on-one session with an AI tutor that you run in your terminal, building a marimo notebook as you go. Read the walkthrough before your first one.
